title: First working day and insurance start date
purpose: Have the employee confirm their first working day, and derive the pension fund insurance start date from it instead of asking for it. The derived date always follows the latest first working day.

stories.title: Employee confirms the first working day
stories.i_want: every new employee to enter and confirm their own first working day in the onboarding questionnaire
stories.so_that: HR and the pension fund work with the employee's current start date, which often moves (for example when the employee negotiates an earlier exit with the old employer), and HR's 'number one' item is never missing
stories.priority_reason: HR calls the first working day the 'number one' item for the pension fund registration; a wrong or outdated date has already caused a wrong registration and weeks of fixing (Julia).

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day is always asked and required
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee fills in the onboarding questionnaire, whatever their place of residence, nationality or civil status
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee reaches the employment start question
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is asked for their first working day at Muster AG as a date (DD.MM.YYYY); the questionnaire cannot be submitted without it

examples.name: Start on the 1st of a month

acceptance_criteria.title: The employee confirms the date because it may have moved
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee is asked for the first working day
acceptance_criteria.then: the question makes clear that the employee should enter the start date as currently agreed with Muster AG, including any change agreed since the offer (for example an earlier exit from the old employer)

acceptance_criteria.title: The first working day is recorded for HR and the pension fund
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: the first working day is recorded for HR (to know when the employee starts) and as the basis of the pension fund insurance start date; only the latest date counts and no history of earlier dates is kept

acceptance_criteria.title: After submission only HR can change the date
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee's start date moves later on
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee can no longer change the first working day in the questionnaire; the change is made by HR (specified in the later HR-side spec)

stories.title: Derive the pension insurance start date from the first working day
stories.i_want: the insurance start date to be derived from the first working day instead of being asked from the employee
stories.so_that: the registration always carries a valid insurance start date on the 1st of a month that matches the employee's actual start, without the employee having to know the fund's rule
stories.priority_reason: The insurance start date is a required field of the pension fund registration and must be the 1st of a month; a wrong date led to an unfriendly letter from the fund and weeks of fixing.

acceptance_criteria.title: Insurance start date is not asked
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee fills in the onboarding questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee goes through all questions
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is never asked for an insurance start date; it is derived from the first working day

acceptance_criteria.title: Start on the 1st of a month: insurance starts that day
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee's first working day is the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.when: the insurance start date is derived
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance start date is the first working day itself

acceptance_criteria.title: Start on any other day: insurance starts on the 1st of the following month
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee's first working day is not the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.when: the insurance start date is derived
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance start date is the 1st of the month following the first working day, also across a year end

examples.name: Start on the 2nd of a month
Start in December, insurance starts next year
Start on the last day of a month

acceptance_criteria.title: Derived date is recorded for the pension fund
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: the derived insurance start date (DD.MM.YYYY, always the 1st of a month) is recorded for the pension fund registration, whose 'Insurance start date' field is required

stories.title: Re-derive the insurance start date when the first working day moves
stories.i_want: the insurance start date to always follow the latest first working day, whenever that date changes
stories.so_that: a moved start date can never leave a wrong insurance start date at the pension fund, as happened with Julia
stories.priority_reason: A missed update after Julia moved her start date caused a wrong date at the fund, an unfriendly letter and weeks of fixing.

acceptance_criteria.title: Employee changes the date before submission
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has entered a first working day and has not yet submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee changes the first working day
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance start date is derived from the new date only; the earlier date plays no role and is not kept

examples.name: Julia moves her start to the 15th (hr_transcript/F-hr_transcript-e18e66)
Start moved one week earlier onto the 1st

acceptance_criteria.title: HR changes the date after submission
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has submitted the questionnaire and HR later changes the first working day (the HR change itself is specified in the later HR-side spec)
acceptance_criteria.when: the insurance start date is needed again
acceptance_criteria.then: it is derived again from the latest first working day by the same rule (the 1st of a month stays that day, any other day gives the 1st of the following month); no earlier insurance start date is kept or reused

examples.name: Latest date moved to the 1st of the following month
